summary: Banco BBVA Argentina filed a routine Form 6-K announcing internal front-line management changes, not a special situation. The bank reported that its AI Transformation Engineering Division will split into two first-line divisions, AI Transformation and Engineering, both reporting to the Executive Chairman. Leandro Alvarez will lead AI Transformation; Alejandro Baccino will lead Engineering. No stake, price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or regulatory clock is disclosed. The filing is organizational, not a forced CEO/CFO departure, so no deal or risk-arb angle applies.
